criteria_review: UC Davis nasal TAE primary concerns nasal tumors with CT assessment of adjacent invasion.

title: Transarterial embolization or chemoembolization for non-resectable canine liver tumors
criteria_review: UC Davis TAE/TACE source concerns unresectable/high-surgical-risk liver cancer,not blood cancer.

title: Postoperative experimental vaccine for dogs with appendicular osteosarcoma
criteria_review: UQ vaccine primary requires nonmetastatic appendicular OSA and planned surgery.

title: Personalized mRNA therapeutic cancer vaccine for canine mast cell tumor
criteria_review: Gamgee current trial page specifically recruits Australian dogs with mast-cell cancer;other countries are waitlist only.

title: Autologous tumour vaccine with doxorubicin after surgery for canine splenic hemangiosarcoma
gap: MediPaws403; найденный индексированный материал подтверждает UMelbourne35274 как проект, но не заменяет перечитанного текущего протокола набора.

title: Whole-abdomen radiation therapy for relapsed feline small-cell gastrointestinal lymphoma
criteria_review: TAMU WART requires biopsy-confirmed small-cell GI lymphoma,newly diagnosed but difficult to medicate OR relapse;7day chemo/steroid washouts and residence within six-hour drive.

title: ReachGlio: SNGR-TNF plus temozolomide for canine high-grade glioma
criteria_review: Puchol ReachGlio primary recruits suspected high-grade canine glioma;other diagnoses are not the stated cohort.

title: Oral verdinexor chemotherapy for canine brain tumors
criteria_review: CSU verdinexor source requires MRI brain tumor,>=10kg and no previous chemotherapy/radiation.

title: Single-fraction radiation therapy for canine transmissible venereal tumor
criteria_review: CSU TVT protocol requires a single radiation treatment,lesion strictly>1cm,no prior surgery/radiation/systemic chemotherapy,and7day immunosuppressant washout.

title: Actionable targeted therapies after amputation or for metastatic canine osteosarcoma
criteria_review: Tufts actionable-target protocol has distinct preamputation and metastatic-postamputation cohorts;minimum15kg and clinician cohort assignment remain.

title: FLASH proton radiation with or without gilvetmab for canine glioma
gap: Прямой Penn glioma FLASH/gilvetmab протокол и сохранённые индексы403. Полные современные ограничения не перечитаны.

title: Organoid-guided targeted therapy for canine and feline solid tumors
criteria_review: Tokyo organoid source explicitly excludes lymphoma/leukemia and requires measurable solid tumor without established curative standard therapy and a supported drug target.

title: Lapatinib for feline transitional cell carcinoma
criteria_review: Tokyo feline lapatinib source permits suspected urinary TCC,not previous chemotherapy,radiation or surgical removal.

title: IDO1 inhibitor therapy for canine bladder cancer
criteria_review: Tokyo IDO1 trial specifically treats canine bladder cancer,including suspected cases for workup.

title: Polymer-conjugated pirarubicin for advanced canine solid tumors
criteria_review: Tokyo polymer-pirarubicin primary explicitly includes HS among unresectable/metastatic solid tumors lacking effective standard treatment.

title: Caninized anti-PD-1 antibody for canine oral malignant melanoma
criteria_review: Current Japanese3site sponsored PD1 protocol is specifically canine oral melanoma with six fortnightly visits.

title: Canine anti-CD20 antibody therapy for lymphoid tumors
criteria_review: Yamaguchi primary describes a canine lymphoid-tumor antiCD20 study with unpublished further tumor-specific criteria.

title: Feline-specific anti-PD-1 antibody for cats with cancer
criteria_review: JSAMC current primary confirms feline-specific antiPD1 clinical research sinceAugust2025;diagnosis-specific criteria are not public.

title: Single-fraction SABR for progressive canine lung metastases
criteria_review: Tufts SABR source requires2–10progressive pulmonary metastases,controlled primary/other disease and safe stereotactic radiation.

title: Survivin peptide cancer vaccine for dogs
criteria_review: NVLU survivin vaccine primary explicitly includes remission and postoperative recurrence-prevention cases. Gross residual tumor is not required;survivin expression OR specified postmortem consent needs investigator assessment.

title: Radiotherapy plus Lavurchin (SQAP) radiosensitizer for feline oral squamous cell carcinoma
criteria_review: Gifu primary offers five radiation days with lavurchin for feline oral SCC.

title: Canine anti-PD-L1 antibody immunotherapy for oral melanoma with lung metastases
criteria_review: Hokkaido primary explicitly includes canine oral melanoma with lung metastases in its antiPDL1 research route.

title: Autogenic tumor-RNA vaccine for Boxer dogs with suspected malignant glioma
criteria_review: UF glioma RNA vaccine primary is restricted to Boxer dogs with MRI-suspected malignant glioma and no previous tumor therapy; breed is not captured by owner form,so it must remain an explicit screening item.

title: HIFU followed by doxorubicin for canine nodal lymphoma
criteria_review: Mars HIFU lymphoma protocol requires nodal B/T lymphoma in prescapular/popliteal node and five doxorubicin treatments beginning8days after HIFU.

title: Proteasome-inhibitor treatment for canine and feline B-cell lymphoid tumors
criteria_review: Nihon proteasome-inhibitor source requires B-cell lineage in dogs/cats;T-cell lymphoma is outside that stated cohort.

title: Oral targeted therapy for mutation-positive canine lung cancer
criteria_review: Nihon lung protocol accepts suspected lung cancer for diagnosis/testing at the center,requires a qualifying mutation,>=4kg and surgery unsuitable/declined;lesion-free postoperative cases excluded.

title: Daunomustine chemotherapy for treatment-naive canine multicentric lymphoma
criteria_review: Illinois daunomustine source requires naive multicentric lymphoma from peripheral nodes and excludes indolent/small-cell lymphoma as well as prior chemotherapy/systemic steroids.

title: Anti-PD-1 antibody immunotherapy for canine histiocytic sarcoma
criteria_review: Tokyo HS antiPD1 primary requires center biopsy,residual detectable HS and no prior immunotherapy or immunosuppressants.

title: SBRT for canine primary pulmonary carcinoma
criteria_review: Tufts primary-lung SBRT requires a single primary pulmonary carcinoma strictly>1cm in shortest diameter,no previous lung-tumor treatment,no regional nodes or pulmonary metastases.

title: SBRT plus dendritic-cell homing hydrogel for canine appendicular osteosarcoma
criteria_review: Illinois SBRT/hydrogel source requires appendicular OSA,no metastasis,strict age>1year,>=5kg and radiation.
